name: image-to-ascii-3d
description: Public web app for color image-to-ASCII conversion with optional depth-map driven Three.js parallax.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @ascii/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ascii/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ascii/core && npm run build --workspace @ascii/parallax-reader
